rationale: Motor vehicle collision with a totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder caused by another driver's negligence.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/structural damage. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's information is documented in the police report. High-severity claim requiring coordination with the other driver's insurer and injury documentation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
